description: Try a page and selectors without saving a job: fetch the page once and answer the prices the selectors find, with the page's HTTP status. Nothing is stored. Hosted scraping is behind a release flag: until it is on for your workspace this answers 501 hosted_scraping_not_enabled. Runs honour robots.txt and fetch only public https pages. Needs a Last Price credential with the commerce:configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code, such as USD.

plan_selector.description: CSS selector for the plan name beside each price.

price_selector.description: CSS selector for the price elements.

url.description: The public page to read. Must start with https://.

name: preview_scrape_job
